theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mass_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsMeasureRepresentation X μ v ∧ μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S.massOn W = μ (W ∩ A)
